rationale.conceptual: Requires correctly implementing the bond-energy Monte Carlo annealing and setting up DFT calculations with appropriate parameters; the underlying physics (band structure, virtual crystal model) is established but non-trivial.
rationale.execution: Multi-step pipeline: custom MC code generation, then many DFT geometry optimizations (58+ runs), strain application, and output assembly; running SIESTA with proper configurations is fragile and orchestration-heavy.

difficulty.reasoning: Task involves implementing Monte Carlo annealing and running numerous DFT calculations with SIESTA to reproduce band gap trends; moderate conceptual difficulty but high execution orchestration.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT calculations on 96‑atom supercells with SIESTA require moderate memory (~8 GB per run); no GPU needed; data volumes are tiny.
